##K-Means manual
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(factoextra)

runnum <- read_excel("E:/magang/Kominfo/VARIABEL MAGANG.xlsx", sheet = "var_fix")
datanum<-data.frame(runnum)
rownames(datanum) <- datanum$Kabupaten.Kota
datanum <- datanum[, -1]
#View(datanum)

# ===== STANDARISASI DATA =====
data1 = scale(datanum)
#View(data1)
set.seed(123)
#==================K-MEANS CLUSTER==========================
#membentuk k means dengan k=5
km_fit = kmeans(data1,centers = 5,iter.max = 300 )
win.graph()
fviz_cluster(km_fit, data = data1)
new_data <- cbind(datanum,data.frame(km_fit$cluster))
#===== PSEUDO - F =====

icdrate = function(new_data, nc, c)
{
  n = dim(new_data)[1]
  p = dim(new_data)[2]
  X = new_data[,1:(p-1)]
  Group = new_data [,p]
  p = dim(X)[2]
  Mean.X = matrix(ncol = p, nrow = (nc+1))
  for (i in 1:nc)
  {
    for (j in 1:p)
    {
      Mean.X[i,j] = mean(X[which(Group==i),j])
      Mean.X[(nc+1),j] = mean(X[,j])
    }
  }
  SST = matrix(ncol=p, nrow=n)
  for (i in 1:n)
  {
    for (j in 1:p)
    {
      SST[i,j] = (X[i,j] - Mean.X[(nc+1),j])^2
    }
  }
  SST = sum(sum(SST))
  SSE = matrix(ncol=p, nrow=n)
  for (i in 1:n)
  {
    for (j in 1:p)
    {
      for (k in 1:nc)
      {
        if (Group[i]==k)
        {
          SSE[i,j] = (X[i,j] - Mean.X[k,j])^2
        }
      }
    }
  }
  SSE = sum(sum(SSE))
  Rsq = (SST-SSE)/SST
  icdrate = 1-Rsq
  Pseudof = (Rsq/(c-1))/((icdrate)/(n-c))
  SSB=SST-SSE
  list(SST=SST, SSE=SSE, SSB=SSB, Rsq=Rsq, icdrate=icdrate, pseudof=Pseudof)
}

icdrate(new_data,length(new_data),5)

# Lihat cluster assignment untuk setiap data
cluster_assignments <- km_fit$cluster

# Lihat keanggotaan fuzzy
km_membership <- km_fit$membership

# Gabungkan hasil clustering dengan data asli
data_km_clusters <- cbind(runnum, Cluster = cluster_assignments)

# Tampilkan hasil clustering
print(head(data_km_clusters))
#View(data_km_clusters)

# Tampilkan keanggotaan fuzzy
print(head(km_membership))
#View(km_membership)


# Menghitung Silhouette Index untuk K-means
library(cluster)
sil_kmeans = silhouette(km_fit$cluster, dist(data1))

# Visualisasi Silhouette Index
win.graph()
fviz_silhouette(sil_kmeans)
cat("Silhouette Index untuk K-means: ", mean(sil_kmeans[, 3]), "\n")

# Visualisasi Cluster
fviz_cluster(km_fit, data = data1)
```

##Fuzzy C Means manual
```{r}
# Memuat library yang dibutuhkan
library(readxl)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(factoextra)
library(e1071)  # Untuk fungsi cmeans

# Membaca data
runnum <- read_excel("E:/magang/Kominfo/VARIABEL MAGANG.xlsx", sheet = "var_fix")
datanum <- data.frame(runnum)
rownames(datanum) <- datanum$Kabupaten.Kota
datanum <- datanum[, -1]

# Standarisasi data
data1 = scale(datanum)
set.seed(123)
# Fungsi untuk menghitung Pseudo-F dan ICDRate
icdrate_fcm <- function(data, membership_matrix, nc) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  p <- ncol(data)
  
  # Hitung pusat kluster
  centers <- t(membership_matrix) %*% data / colSums(membership_matrix)
  
  # Hitung SST
  mean_data <- colMeans(data)
  SST <- sum(rowSums((data - mean_data)^2))
  
  # Hitung SSE
  SSE <- 0
  for (i in 1:nc) {
    SSE <- SSE + sum(membership_matrix[, i] * rowSums((data - centers[i, ])^2))
  }
  
  # Hitung Rsq, ICDRate, dan Pseudo-F
  Rsq <- (SST - SSE) / SST
  ICDRate <- 1 - Rsq
  PseudoF <- (Rsq / (nc - 1)) / (ICDRate / (n - nc))
  
  list(SST = SST, SSE = SSE, Rsq = Rsq, ICDRate = ICDRate, PseudoF = PseudoF)
}

# Jumlah kluster
nc <- 5

# Fuzzy C-Means Clustering
fcm_result <- cmeans(data1, centers = nc, iter.max = 300, m = 2)

# Menghitung Pseudo-F dan ICDRate
result <- icdrate_fcm(data1, fcm_result$membership, nc)

# Menampilkan hasil
print(result)

# Visualisasi cluster
win.graph()
fviz_cluster(list(data = data1, cluster = fcm_result$cluster), geom = "point")

# Lihat cluster assignment untuk setiap data
cluster_assignments <- fcm_result$cluster

# Lihat keanggotaan fuzzy 63
fcm_membership <- fcm_result$membership

# Gabungkan hasil clustering dengan data asli
data_fcm_clusters <- cbind(runnum, Cluster = cluster_assignments)

# Tampilkan hasil clustering
print(head(data_fcm_clusters))
#View(data_fcm_clusters)
library(openxlsx)
#write.xlsx(data_fcm_clusters, "E:/magang/Kominfo/data_fcm_clusters.xlsx")

# Tampilkan keanggotaan fuzzy
print(head(fcm_membership))
#View(fcm_membership)
#write.xlsx(fcm_membership, "E:/magang/Kominfo/fcm_membership.xlsx")

# Konversi keanggotaan fuzzy menjadi kluster berdasarkan keanggotaan tertinggi
fcm_cluster <- max.col(fcm_result$membership)

# Menghitung Silhouette Index
sil_fcm <- silhouette(fcm_cluster, dist(data1))

# Menampilkan hasil Silhouette Index
summary(sil_fcm)

# Plot Silhouette Index
plot(sil_fcm, main = "Silhouette Plot for Fuzzy C-Means")

# Nilai rata-rata Silhouette Index
cat("Silhouette Index untuk Fuzzy C Means: ", mean(sil_fcm[, 3]), "\n")
```

## Fuzzy C Means elbow
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(NbClust)
library(readxl)
library(e1071)
library(openxlsx)
# Load data
dataTA <- read_excel("E:/magang/Kominfo/VARIABEL MAGANG.xlsx", sheet = "var_fix")
View(dataTA)
data_final <- dataTA[, -1]
View(data_final)
# Menentukan jumlah klaster optimal dengan metode Elbow 
set.seed(123) # Untuk konsistensi hasil
fviz_nbclust(data_final, kmeans, method = "wss") +
 geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = 2) + # Tambahkan garis vertikal di sekitar jumlah klaster optimal (misalnya 3)
 labs(title = "Elbow Method for Optimal K") +
 theme_minimal()
# Anda juga bisa menggunakan metode NbClust untuk mendapatkan jumlah klaster optimal
# nbclust_result <- NbClust(data_final, distance = "euclidean", min.nc = 2, max.nc = 10, method = "kmeans")
# fviz_nbclust(nbclust_result)
# Kode ini akan menunjukkan jumlah klaster optimal berdasarkan beberapa metrik
# Tentukan jumlah cluster yang diinginkan (misalnya 3 cluster)
num_clusters <- 3
# Lakukan clustering menggunakan Fuzzy C-Means
fcm_result <- cmeans(data_final, centers = num_clusters, m = 2, iter.max = 500, verbose = TRUE)
# Hasil dari clustering
# Lihat cluster assignment untuk setiap data
cluster_assignments <- fcm_result$cluster
# Lihat keanggotaan fuzzy 63
membership <- fcm_result$membership
# Gabungkan hasil clustering dengan data asli
data_with_clusters <- cbind(dataTA, Cluster = cluster_assignments)
# Tampilkan hasil clustering
print(head(data_with_clusters))
View(data_with_clusters)
# Tampilkan keanggotaan fuzzy
print(head(membership))
View(membership)
# Hitung silhouette index menggunakan keanggotaan fuzzy dari Fuzzy C-Means
diss_matrix <- dist(data_final) # Membuat matriks jarak dari data asli
# Silhouette membutuhkan cluster label yang eksplisit
silhouette_score <- silhouette(cluster_assignments, diss_matrix)
# Tampilkan hasil silhouette score
print(silhouette_score)
# Plot silhouette
fviz_silhouette(silhouette_score)
# Rata-rata silhouette index
avg_silhouette <- mean(silhouette_score[, 3])
cat("Average Silhouette Index: ", avg_silhouette, "\n")
# Menghitung Partition Coefficient (PC)
n <- nrow(data_final) # Jumlah baris dalam data
pc <- sum(membership^2) / n # Gunakan jumlah baris data untuk pembagian
cat("Partition Coefficient (PC):", pc, "\n")
```

#Fuzzy C Means manual 2
```{r}

runnum = read_excel("E:/magang/Kominfo/VARIABEL MAGANG.xlsx", sheet = "var_fix")
datanum<-data.frame(runnum)
rownames(datanum) <- datanum$Kabupaten.Kota
datanum <- datanum[, -1]


# ===== STANDARISASI DATA =====
data = scale(datanum)

# Install library fclust
#install.packages("fclust")
library(fclust)

# Fuzzy C-Means clustering
fcm_fit <- FKM(data1, k = 6, m = 2, stand = FALSE)  # k adalah jumlah kluster, m adalah parameter fuzzy

# Matriks keanggotaan
membership_matrix <- fcm_fit$U

# Centroid
centroids <- fcm_fit$H

# Fungsi untuk ICDRate dan Pseudo-F
icdrate_fcm <- function(data, membership, centroids, m) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  k <- ncol(membership)
  
  # Hitung centroid berbasis fuzzy
  SST <- 0
  SSE <- 0
  total_mean <- colMeans(data)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:k) {
      SST <- SST + sum((data[i, ] - total_mean)^2)
      SSE <- SSE + membership[i, j]^m * sum((data[i, ] - centroids[j, ])^2)
    }
  }
  
  Rsq <- (SST - SSE) / SST
  icdrate <- 1 - Rsq
  pseudo_f <- (Rsq / (k - 1)) / ((icdrate) / (n - k))
  list(SST = SST, SSE = SSE, Rsq = Rsq, icdrate = icdrate, pseudof = pseudo_f)
}

# Hitung Pseudo-F dan ICDRate untuk hasil FCM
result <- icdrate_fcm(data1, membership_matrix, centroids, m = 2)
print(result)
```

## Fuzzy C Means Loop
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(NbClust)
library(readxl)
library(e1071)
library(openxlsx)

# Load data
dataTA <- read_excel("E:/magang/Kominfo/VARIABEL MAGANG.xlsx", sheet = "var_fix")
View(dataTA)
data_final <- dataTA[, -1]
View(data_final)

#pseduo icdrate manual
pseudo_f_icdrate_fcm <- function(data, centers, m = 2) {
  # Lakukan clustering menggunakan Fuzzy C-Means
  fcm_result <- cmeans(data, centers = centers, m = m, iter.max = 500)
  membership <- fcm_result$membership
  cluster_centers <- fcm_result$centers
  
  n <- nrow(data)
  p <- ncol(data)
  
  # Rata-rata global
  global_mean <- colMeans(data)
  
  # Total Sum of Squares (SST)
  SST <- sum(rowSums((data - global_mean)^2))
  
  # Sum of Squares Error (SSE)
  SSE <- 0
  for (k in 1:centers) {
    SSE <- SSE + sum(membership[, k]^m * rowSums((data - cluster_centers[k, ])^2))
  }
  
  # R-squared
  Rsq <- (SST - SSE) / SST
  
  # ICD Rate
  icdrate <- 1 - Rsq
  
  # Pseudo-F
  pseudo_f <- (Rsq / (centers - 1)) / (icdrate / (n - centers))
  
  list(SST = SST, SSE = SSE, Rsq = Rsq, icdrate = icdrate, PseudoF = pseudo_f)
}

#pseduo-f icdrate
max_clusters <- 10
pseudo_f_scores <- numeric(max_clusters)

for (k in 2:max_clusters) {
  result <- pseudo_f_icdrate_fcm(data_final, centers = k)
  pseudo_f_scores[k] <- result$PseudoF
}

# Temukan jumlah cluster optimal
optimal_clusters <- which.max(pseudo_f_scores[2:max_clusters]) + 1
cat("Jumlah cluster optimal:", optimal_clusters, "\n")

# Plot Pseudo-F
plot(2:max_clusters, pseudo_f_scores[2:max_clusters], type = "b",
     xlab = "Jumlah Cluster", ylab = "Pseudo-F",
     main = "Pseudo-F untuk Fuzzy C-Means")


# Lakukan clustering menggunakan Fuzzy C-Means
fcm_result <- cmeans(data_final, centers = optimal_clusters, m = 3, iter.max = 500, verbose = TRUE)

# Hasil dari clustering
cluster_assignments <- fcm_result$cluster
membership <- fcm_result$membership

data_with_clusters <- cbind(dataTA, Cluster = cluster_assignments)

# Tampilkan hasil clustering
print(head(data_with_clusters))
View(data_with_clusters)

# Hitung silhouette index menggunakan keanggotaan fuzzy dari Fuzzy C-Means
diss_matrix <- dist(data_final)
silhouette_score <- silhouette(cluster_assignments, diss_matrix)

# Tampilkan hasil silhouette score
print(silhouette_score)

# Plot silhouette
fviz_silhouette(silhouette_score)

# Rata-rata silhouette index
avg_silhouette <- mean(silhouette_score[, 3])
cat("Average Silhouette Index: ", avg_silhouette, "\n")

# Menghitung Partition Coefficient (PC)
n <- nrow(data_final)
pc <- sum(membership^2) / n
cat("Partition Coefficient (PC):", pc, "\n")
```

#K-Means Loop
```{r}
# Memuat library yang dibutuhkan
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# Membaca data
runnum = read_excel("E:/magang/Kominfo/VARIABEL MAGANG.xlsx", sheet = "var_fix")
datanum <- data.frame(runnum)
rownames(datanum) <- datanum$Kabupaten.Kota
datanum <- datanum[, -1]

# Standarisasi data
data1 = scale(datanum)

# Fungsi ICDRate dan Pseudo-F
icdrate = function(data, nc, centers) {
  n = nrow(data)
  p = ncol(data) - 1
  X = data[, 1:p]  # Data tanpa kolom kluster
  Group = as.factor(data[, p + 1])  # Kolom kluster
  Mean.X = matrix(ncol = p, nrow = nc + 1)
  
  # Rata-rata per kelompok dan total
  for (i in 1:nc) {
    Mean.X[i, ] = colMeans(X[Group == i, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  Mean.X[nc + 1, ] = colMeans(X)
  
  # Menghitung SST
  SST = sum(rowSums((X - Mean.X[nc + 1, ])^2))
  
  # Menghitung SSE
  SSE = 0
  for (i in 1:nc) {
    SSE = SSE + sum(rowSums((X[Group == i, , drop = FALSE] - Mean.X[i, ])^2))
  }
  
  Rsq = (SST - SSE) / SST
  icdrate = 1 - Rsq
  PseudoF = (Rsq / (centers - 1)) / (icdrate / (n - centers))
  list(SST = SST, SSE = SSE, Rsq = Rsq, icdrate = icdrate, pseudof = PseudoF)
}

# Loop untuk mencari jumlah kluster optimal
max_clusters = 10
pseudo_f_scores = numeric(max_clusters)
icd_rates = numeric(max_clusters)

for (k in 2:max_clusters) {
  km_fit = kmeans(data1, centers = k, iter.max = 300, nstart = 10)
  new_data = cbind(data1, cluster = km_fit$cluster)
  result = icdrate(new_data, nc = k, centers = k)
  
  pseudo_f_scores[k] = result$pseudof
  icd_rates[k] = result$icdrate
}

# Visualisasi hasil
plot(2:max_clusters, pseudo_f_scores[2:max_clusters], type = "b", pch = 19, col = "blue",
     xlab = "Number of Clusters", ylab = "Pseudo-F Score", main = "Optimal Number of Clusters")
lines(2:max_clusters, icd_rates[2:max_clusters], type = "b", pch = 19, col = "red")
legend("topright", legend = c("Pseudo-F", "ICD Rate"), col = c("blue", "red"), pch = 19)


```
